title: Endometriosis transcriptomic reanalysis: source audit and sample-level gene associations
description: Fixed processed-input reproducibility package for source auditing and sample-level reanalysis of published endometriosis transcriptomic features. Includes nine fixed model fits, separate HC3 sensitivities, four R figure scripts, exact processed matrices, reference tables and provenance records. No diagnostic classifier or AUC analysis. Original code is MIT licensed; third-party source data retain their terms, detailed in DATA_LICENSE.md.
